builtBy: Research by hand on 2026-11-14 for the 41 boys basketball teams: the schools’ athletics sites and their own pages, read by script (a handle a page links, names or holds in its settings), student papers, and web searches limited to Instagram; every profile kept was then opened in a browser. Each record’s note says where its handle was found. A second round on 2026-11-27 covered the 122 boys basketball teams then without a record (the registry having grown to 133): the same sources and searches limited to instagram.com. Instagram answered most anonymous profile views that day with its login page, so a record whose profile could not be opened says so in its note and was kept, at the owner’s direction, on the page or search result it rests on.
notes: Links, not sources: no fact on the site is read from an account (README "Instagram accounts", DATA-SOURCES §1.10).

A team’s account is its boys basketball program’s own, or one the school’s boys and girls teams share (its note says so); never a girls-only account, the school’s or the athletics department’s account for every sport, a booster club’s, a club team’s or a player’s.

A profile whose name and bio do not say which school it is (several schools here share a name with one elsewhere) is left out unless a page of the school’s links it or the profile links the school’s own page.
No record means no account we could find and check on the day, not that there is none: 26 of the 133 teams have one (2026-11-27).
